notes.title: Lots of Balls keeps growing!
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/5qFQfUZggv7pSRcVzi/giphy.gif

                 Lots of Balls keeps growing with it's major updates!

Since release we've added:

 Quick Play
 Mouse support for player movement
 New Extra: Pigs in Space
 New Extra: Space Clicker
 Several improvements and bug fixes!


Keep updated with Lots of Balls here:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/paddleteampr
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7B1KOT9XZAsIQa61aDX9sQ/videos


Thank you for playing with Lots of Balls!

notes.title: Version 1.3 is out!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31866549/afd1345c512f9b5b70c262d14778d83e87f33136.png

                                  Our third major update is out!

What's new?

 New Special Extra: Space Clicker
 Space Shooter improvements
 New Intro, banner and icon
 Bug Fixes

If you have any feedback or suggestions send us a message on the Steam Discussions or via our email!

notes.title: Our Second Major Update is Out!
notes.content:
Change log:

- New Extra: Pigs in Space!
- Tons of bug fixes!

notes.title: Our First Major Update is Out!
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is now available!

Change log:

- Mouse Support added! (enable it on the in-game options menu)
- Quick Play added!
- Loading tips added
- Bug Fixes
